written.summary: The child told about football training at the sports hall with the under fifteens. They mentioned going the wrong way during a drill, being told to go to the other cone, everyone resetting, getting it right next time, doing the drill for another ten minutes, playing in the match, finishing training, and the coach saying they will do fitness next week.
